cases.source:
def mark(value):
    print(value)
    return value
def main():
    result = mark(1) < mark(2) < mark(3)
    other = mark(3) < mark(2) < mark(1)
    print(mark("") and mark("never"))
    print(mark(()) or mark("fallback"))
    return result, other

def selected(value=(1, "😀")):
    return value
def main():
    first=selected()
    alias=selected
    second=selected()
    return first is second, selected is alias, first

def main():
    error=TypeError("bad value")
    print(error is error)
    raise error

async def selected(value=(1,"😀")):
    print("inside")
    return value
async def main():
    pending=selected()
    print("before")
    first=await pending
    print("after")
    second=await selected()
    return first is second, first

from JavaScript import Promise
async def main():
    error=TypeError("rejected")
    pending=Promise.reject(error)
    await pending

from JavaScript import Promise
def callback(value):
    print("once")
    error=TypeError("callback error")
    raise error
async def main():
    return await Promise.resolve(1).then(callback)

async def inner():
    return 1//0
async def main():
    return await inner()
